title: UC6 loan 10 multi-disbursement schedule: the six observed principal components sum to the total disbursed across three tranches and amortize to zero (Tier-D MNT replay)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the WHOLE repayment schedule of UC6 loan 10 from the Tier-D MNT replay of LoanUpdateApprovedAmount.feature. Unlike the single-disbursement vectors on this seam (LN-L10, LN-TD-L10-loan-1-pending-amortizes-to-zero), loan 10 is a MULTI-DISBURSEMENT loan: its schedule opens with THREE disbursement rows (300/200/500 minor-major tranches) and then six repayment rows. request.schedule_amortization transcribes repaymentSchedule.totalPrincipalDisbursed 1000.000000 -> "100000" minor units and the six observed repayment-period principalDue values 169.90/170.05/170.05/170.05/170.05/149.90 -> 16990/17005/17005/17005/17005/14990. The three disbursement rows carry NO principalDue and are NOT components, exactly as period 0 is excluded on the single-disbursement captures. expect.principal_sum_minor and expect.final_principal_balance_minor are TRANSCRIPTIONS, not recomputations: the six components sum to 100000 = totalPrincipalDisbursed, and the final period's principalLoanBalanceOutstanding is 0.000000, so the final balance is "0". The multi-tranche disbursement structure itself (300/200/500) is not representable at this seam, whose request carries a single disbursed-principal scalar and a component list; the total is the observed scalar the seam admits. Nothing was computed by this promotion.
